thread:
maria.p: heads up — multiple Dedicated customers in asia-east are hitting 429s on allocation. customer-repro: POST /v1/dedicated/allocate -> 429. reported by CS, ticket INC-2026-789.

devon.k: saw that. any latency increases too or just immediate 429s?

maria.p: both. placement attempts hang ~6s then 429. some requests show long queueing in the placement service logs.

samir: @devon.k i pulled the placement logs for today, looks like AZ a-3 is hitting GPU allocation stockout. autoscaler didn't add nodes — quota blocked. snippet: 
```
2026-03-17T09:12:34Z placement: allocate attempt failed: no-capacity gpu:v100 ASG=dedicated-asia-east-a3
2026-03-17T09:12:35Z autoscaler: scale_up suppressed: quota_exceeded (project=redwood-prod, reason=guest-gpu-limit)
```

chandra: ugh, quota_exceeded — is that a cloud project quota or our soft cap?

samir: cloud project quota. customer reserved pool is full; new allocations are hitting the shared pool which is at 100%.

maria.p: CS notes some customers also saw billing errors around the same time (card auth failed -> allocation retried -> 429). could be cascading.

devon.k: ok mitigation ideas: 1) divert new allocs for affected tenants to fallback region (na-west2) 2) increase reserved capacity for priority customers 3) request emergency quota bump with cloud provider. which is fastest?

chandra: quickest is (1) and (3) in parallel. I'll open a quota request but those take time. Samir — can you add a routing rule for the impacted tenant IDs to prefer na-west2?

samir: yes. I can push a temporary routing override. will update placement policy to prefer region=na-west2 for tenant tags [cust-88, cust-102]. that should reduce 429s in ~30s.

ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-789 created by maria.p — severity=P2 — oncall=sre-team — runbook=/playbooks/dedicated-region-fallback.md

maria.p: repro steps for support: 
1) curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/dedicated/allocate -d '{"tenant":"cust-88","pool":"gpu-large","region":"asia-east"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'
2) Watch for 429 and allocation_error: no-capacity in response

support-bot: Noted — I've updated the customer ticket with the repro and temporary mitigation (routing override to na-west2).

devon.k: followups: add alert for "placement queue depth > 500" and a dashboard showing reserved vs shared pool usage per region. also check billing retry logic so failed auth doesn't trigger extra allocation retries (we might be exhausting retries).

chandra: agree. I'll schedule a postmortem if the quota bump doesn't land in 24h. for now, samir please proceed with routing override and post the change ID here.

samir: routing override applied: change-id r-20260317-002. verified allocations for cust-88 now hitting na-west2 successfully (no 429) :white_check_mark:.

maria.p: thanks. we'll keep CS updated and monitor invoice/billing anomalies. tagging @oncall-sre for 1hr watch. :eyes:

ops-bot: oncall duty assigned to chandra for 60 minutes.

devon.k: note for follow-up: evaluate adding "quota buffer" automation to spin fallback capacity when shared pool > 80% to avoid manual routing overrides in future.

maria.p: logging this in the post-incident tracker -> INC-2026-789/notes. good work team. :thumbsup:
